channelTitle: Why athletes keep a jar of this in their gym bag
hook: A leg cramp hits at 2am, and Grandma June doesn't reach for water first, she reaches for the pickle jar.
remedy: A small shot of pickle juice at the first sign of a muscle cramp is an old home remedy that's actually caught on with athletes too, often easing the cramp faster than plain water alone.
steps: Keep a jar of pickles (and their brine) in the fridge
At the first twinge of a cramp, take a small shot of the juice, about an ounce
Sip slowly rather than gulping, and follow with water afterward
caution: Pickle juice is high in sodium - go easy if you're watching your salt intake or have high blood pressure.
cta: Has pickle juice ever saved you from a middle-of-the-night cramp? Tell Grandma June about it.
